def mvcc.rangeInv (keys_ptr modifies_ptr creates_ptr versions_ptr totalCount_ptr : Loc) (vis : List
    mvcc.IdxEntry) (atRev limit : w64) (withTotal : Bool) (i : Nat) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ keys modifies creates versions total cl,
      typedPointsto keys_ptr keys (DFrac.own 1) ∗
        typedPointsto modifies_ptr modifies (DFrac.own 1) ∗
          typedPointsto creates_ptr creates (DFrac.own 1) ∗
            typedPointsto versions_ptr versions (DFrac.own 1) ∗
              typedPointsto totalCount_ptr total (DFrac.own 1) ∗
                mvcc.ownKeys keys
                    (List.map Prod.fst
                      (mvcc.takeLimit (mvcc.limitOf limit) (mvcc.entryAnswers (List.take i vis) atRev))) ∗
                  ownSlice modifies
                      (List.map (fun x => mvcc.revVal x.snd.fst)
                        (mvcc.takeLimit (mvcc.limitOf limit) (mvcc.entryAnswers (List.take i vis) atRev)))
                      (DFrac.own 1) ∗
                    ownSliceCap go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.Revision modifies (DFrac.own 1) ∗
                      ownSlice creates cl (DFrac.own 1) ∗
                        ownSliceCap go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.Revision creates (DFrac.own 1) ∗
                          ownSlice versions
                              (List.map (fun x => x.snd.snd.snd)
                                (mvcc.takeLimit (mvcc.limitOf limit) (mvcc.entryAnswers (List.take i vis) atRev)))
                              (DFrac.own 1) ∗
                            ownSliceCap w64 versions (DFrac.own 1) ∗
                              ⌜total =
                                    W64
                                      ↑(mvcc.totalOf (mvcc.limitOf limit) withTotal
                                          (mvcc.entryAnswers (List.take i vis) atRev).length) ∧
                                  List.map go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.Revision.Main' cl =
                                    List.map (fun x => x.snd.snd.fst)
                                      (mvcc.takeLimit (mvcc.limitOf limit) (mvcc.entryAnswers (List.take i vis) atRev))⌝)

theorem mvcc.ownKeys_snoc [go_etcd_io.etcd.cache.v3.Assumptions] (keys' : GoSlice) (kss : List
    GoSlice) (ks : List GoString) (hlen : kss.length = ks.length) (s : GoSlice) (k : GoString) : ⊢
    ([∗list] p ∈ kss.zip ks, ownSlice p.fst p.snd DFrac.discard) -∗ ownSlice keys' (kss ++ [s])
    (DFrac.own 1) -∗ ownSliceCap GoSlice keys' (DFrac.own 1) -∗ ownSlice s k DFrac.discard -∗
    mvcc.ownKeys keys' (ks ++ [k])
